strings.name: Toshihiro Mibe
strings.role: President and CEO of Honda Motor
strings.summary: Toshihiro Mibe moved from automotive powertrain research and development into Honda's group management, becoming president and CEO in 2021. Honda pursued electrification during his tenure but also adjusted its strategy amid market changes and business pressures, including the 2026 cancellation of development and launch of three EV models planned for North American production.
strings.coverageNote: Checked through November 17, 2026. Honda R&D is distinguished from Honda Motor, announcements from effective appointments, corporate strategy from individual achievements, and integration talks from completed transactions. Reform goals are not treated as achieved results.
strings.influence.rationale: Has led research and development and group management at Honda, advancing adjustments to vehicle electrification and powertrain strategy.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Completed the engineering master's program at Hiroshima University in 1987 and joined Honda that April.
strings.facts.f2.label: Research and development career
strings.facts.f2.value: Worked extensively in automotive and powertrain R&D, becoming president of Honda R&D in April 2019.
strings.highlights.h1.title: From R&D to group management
strings.highlights.h1.text: Led Honda R&D before succeeding Takahiro Hachigo at Honda Motor in 2021.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Electrification strategy adjustments
strings.highlights.h2.text: In 2026 Honda announced cancellation of three models planned for North America and revised financial forecasts; this did not end all EV projects.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Management reform roundtable published
strings.timeline.t1.text: The integrated report included his discussion with other executives about organizational and business reform; this is the report's publication date.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Honda revises electrification plans
strings.timeline.t2.text: The company canceled the planned North American Honda 0 SUV, Honda 0 Saloon and Acura RSX models, expecting losses and revising earnings forecasts.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Nissan integration talks end
strings.timeline.t3.text: The companies terminated the integration MOU and discussions while retaining a strategic partnership framework; no merger was completed.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Title changes under new governance structure
strings.timeline.t4.text: His official biography records becoming director, president and representative executive officer, separate from his presidency beginning in April.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Becomes Honda president and CEO
strings.timeline.t5.text: Succeeded Takahiro Hachigo; the succession was announced on February 19 that year.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Leads Honda R&D
strings.timeline.t6.text: Became president and representative director of the R&D subsidiary, not yet president of the Honda Motor group.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Becomes Honda Motor operating officer
strings.timeline.t7.text: Took responsibility for automotive powertrain business and related production management.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Completes master's program and joins Honda
strings.timeline.t8.text: Completed Hiroshima University's engineering master's program and joined Honda in April, subsequently working mainly in automotive R&D.
